effect.name: Halftone Plus
effect.desc: Two-color rotatable halftone dot screen with dot size/spacing/scale, elliptical dots, and tone controls. Extras: color-match-driven UV displacement of the background, an edges-only mode that masks the halftone by a blurred Sobel edge detect, and sampled-color dot mode.

switch.label: Use sampled color for dots (when off uses colours)
